title: Stability
statement:
Weakly étale morphisms, as defined in [sk-def-pe-morphisms] and [def-weil-weakly-etale-morphism], are stable under base change and
composition, and the property is local on source and target for the Zariski topology.
Every $X$-morphism between two weakly étale $X$-schemes is weakly étale. Affine pro-étale
morphisms (affine spectra of ind-étale ring maps [def-weil-pbc-ind-etale-algebra]) are stable under affine base change and composition.

proof.text: Use Mathlib's existing IsStableUnderBaseChange instance for WeaklyEtale. Its proof writes WeaklyEtale as Flat intersect diagonal Flat, and applies base-change stability of flatness to both factors. This is exactly the unit's first base-change argument, already formalized in Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/Morphisms/WeaklyEtale.lean.

Use Mathlib's existing IsMultiplicative instance for WeaklyEtale, whose superclass supplies IsStableUnderComposition. Its proof uses the stability of Flat and diagonal Flat, implementing the composite-diagonal factorization in the unit's first paragraph.

Use Mathlib's existing IsZariskiLocalAtSource and IsZariskiLocalAtTarget instances for WeaklyEtale. These use the identity WeaklyEtale = Flat intersect diagonal Flat and the corresponding locality instances, so implement the unit's locality argument.

Given u : U to S, v : V to S and f : U to V with f followed by v equal to u, rewrite WeaklyEtale u to obtain WeaklyEtale (f followed by v). Mathlib's WeaklyEtale.of_comp f v cancels the weakly etale v, giving WeaklyEtale f. Its HasOfPostcompProperty instance is proved using the weakly etale diagonal, so this reuses the unit's between-objects argument.

Apply proAffineEtale.comp_mem to the two affine pro-etale maps. Use the source library's IsStableUnderBaseChangeAlong instance for the final affine map; its IsAffineHom hypothesis is inferred from affineness of source and target. Both instances are proved in WeilConjectures/AlgebraicGeometry/Morphisms/ProAffineEtale.lean. Composition is reduced there via proAffineEtale_iff_appTop to RingHom.IndEtale.comp; base change is proved directly for the pro-presentation using etale base change and affineness. This uses exactly the existing pro-affine-etale notion of sk-def-pe-morphisms, without new presentations or arbitrary choices.
